Class Par

java.lang.Object
forj.Par
public final class Par extends Object
Parallel combinators for Callable, in the spirit of cats-effect's parMapN and parTraverse.

Like everything over Callable in forj, these are lazy: they return a Callable and nothing runs until call(). Each call opens one StructuredTaskScopePREVIEW, forks every task on its own virtual thread and joins them. If any task fails, the others are cancelled (interrupted) and call() throws that task's exception. 

Callable<String> dashboard = forj {
    parts <- Par.mapN(get("/profile"), get("/orders"), get("/recommendations"), Parts::new);
    shipping <- get("/shipping/" + itemCount(parts.orders()));   // runs after all three
} yield render(parts, shipping);

Uses StructuredTaskScope, a preview API in JDK 27 and 28 (forj builds with --enable-preview throughout).
